{{- /* First header row, matched to the GoodData Cloud docs (DP-3706): the GoodData Learn logo and label on the left, the cross-product links from [menu.main] in the middle, the "Request a demo" button ([params.headerCTA]) on the right. Markup and class names follow Cloud's navbar.html (gdc-cloud-docs) and gooddata-docs-theme at bd04776 (header-menu.html, header-right.html); styles are in assets/css/gd-header.css. Cloud's links are static config too, not a feed. The logo goes where the menu's isHome entry (Documentation) goes, as on Cloud, falling back to this site's docs home; the SDK docs home is the first sidebar link. Below lg only the logo and a hamburger show. Cloud opens its menu with a hidden checkbox; here it is a button with aria-expanded, wired by disclosure.js (main.js), and the panel opens with .is-open. */ -}} {{- $menu := site.Menus.main -}} {{- $homeURL := printf "%s/" site.Params.homeSlug | relURL -}} {{- range $menu }}{{ if .Params.isHome }}{{ $homeURL = .URL }}{{ end }}{{ end -}}
